scene.videoLabel: FlowFlow on an iPhone, in video
lines: Calendar: client call at 10, then two hours without Slack.
Remind me to send the client the quote before noon.
Meeting notes: he wants “just a small button”. That's three screens.
Call recap: the client wants everything by Friday, the budget in January, and I want a holiday in February.
Remind me to bill Tuesday's “small tweaks”.
Note: three hours on a one-line bug. Do I bill the line?
FlowFlow note: the iPhone build passes first try. Ferris is proud.
Remind me to prepare Monday's demo: the iPhone flow, the sync with the Mac, and Hermes sending the recap.
Block Friday afternoon for the Apple review, nothing else.
Note: never ship on a Friday night. Not even this one.
Move the team check-in to 2 pm, the client pushed back.
Remind me to send the proposal Thursday at 9.
Remind me to chase September's invoice on Monday.
The client approves the mockup. He just wants the logo bigger.
Decision: v1 ships without dark mode. Nobody cries.
FlowFlow note: dictate on the train with no signal, and find the note filed when I arrive. It works.
Remind me to answer the App Store reviews tonight.
Lesson of the day: reread the quote before sending it. Both times.
Calendar: lunch break at 1 pm. Away from the screen.
Note: drink water. Coffee doesn't count.
Remind me to call my mum on Sunday. She asks if the app is finished.
Remind me to shut the laptop at 7 pm. For real this time.
